relations: The calm tidal pool mirrors the overcast sky; any surface disturbance would break the cloud reflection into ripples.
The reflected treeline on the right persists only while the water remains still enough to act as a mirror.
The pebble beach and distant building cast faint reflections that would fade if the water level rises or waves arrive.
Sky brightness near the horizon corresponds to matching luminance in the water's reflection below.
